# Alexander disease (*GFAP*) corpus search log

*Generated by `analysis/corpus/corpus_summary.py` from this folder's files on 2026-10-19. Re-running the scripts reproduces the numbers, subject to database changes since the search date.*

## PubMed query

```
("Alexander disease"[tiab] OR "Alexander's disease"[tiab] OR "Alexander Disease"[MeSH] OR (GFAP[tiab] AND (leukodystroph*[tiab] OR leukoencephalopath*[tiab]))) AND ("case reports"[pt] OR "case report"[tiab] OR patient*[tiab] OR cohort[tiab] OR family[tiab] OR families[tiab])
```

- **Run:** 2026-10-19, by `pipeline/extract/corpus/build_manifest.py` with the disease's query and filter in `configs/diseases.yaml`.
- **Dates:** database inception to the search date (pre-registration §5.1).
- **Hits:** 513.

## Seeds

| File | Rows |
|---|---|
| `seeds/background_bibliography.csv` | 4 |
| `seeds/refs_grossi2024.csv` | 34 |
| `seeds/refs_prust2011.csv` | 40 |

- `background_bibliography.csv`: this disease's entries in `background/manifest.csv`, minus comparator holdouts (`disease_seeds.py background`).
- `refs_*.csv`: reference lists of the key reviews from the Europe PMC references API (`seeds_from_references.py`). These lists can be partial.
- **Not used:** ClinVar or OMIM citation lists (pre-registration §5.1). Papers seeded from ClinVar: 0. The Europe PMC full-text search and LitVar were not run.

**Manifest:** 539 records.

## Screening (title and abstract)

- **Route:** Claude Code helper agents (Sonnet), batches of up to 100 records, each with its own scratch directory, following `pipeline/extract/claude_code/prompts/screen_v2.md` with this disease's block from `configs/diseases.yaml`. Prompt hash in `screening/screening_log.json`.
- **Relevance:** no 148, unclear 100, yes 291.
- **In the extraction corpus:** 363 (relevance yes or unclear; case report, case series/cohort or review).
  - by relevance: unclear 74, yes 289;
  - by study type: case report 265, case series/cohort 78, review/meta-analysis 20.
- **Human check:** not yet done. `screening/study_type_spotcheck.csv` holds 20 rows (seed 20261018) for it; pre-registration §5.1 asks for a random 10% of inclusions.
- **Full-text screening:** not yet done. It will remove some papers, especially "unclear" ones.

## Full text

- **Fetched:** 74 of 363 corpus papers (20.4%) as JATS XML from Europe PMC or PMC (`fetch_fulltext.py`). Access status in the corpus: paywalled 250, europepmc_xml 65, not_found 39, pmc_efetch_xml 9.
- **"Paywalled" here means no PMC copy.** Unpaywall was skipped because `UNPAYWALL_EMAIL` is unset. Of the papers without full text, 61 more list a free or open copy outside PMC in Europe PMC (`oa_elsewhere.json`); with them, at most 135 of 363 (37.2%). Not fetched.
- **Relevance yes, primary papers** (case reports and series): 283; with full text 66 (23.3%).
- **D-08 (open; placeholder: at least 15 accessible reports and at least 50%):** not met on fetched full text.
